items.stem: What should you establish before writing a fix for a reported defect?

options.text: A reliable reproduction of the bug
options.rationale: Correct: a reproducible case anchors the fix and the regression test.
Merging comes after the verified fix, not before.
Deploying before a fix exists is premature.

options.text: A new feature branch with no changes
options.rationale: An empty branch does not establish reproduction.

items.explanation: Correct: a reproducible case anchors the fix and the regression test.

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep an AI-assisted fix safe to merge? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Review and understand the AI-proposed change before accepting it
options.rationale: Correct: human review prevents merging code you cannot explain.

options.text: Add a Playwright test that fails before the fix and passes after
options.rationale: Correct: a regression test proves the fix and guards against recurrence.

options.text: Push the AI change straight to the main branch
options.rationale: Bypassing PR review removes a safety gate.

items.explanation: Correct: human review prevents merging code you cannot explain.

items.stem: A good regression test for a fixed bug should do what?

options.text: Fail on the buggy code and pass once the fix is applied
options.rationale: Correct: a red-then-green test proves it actually guards the bug.

options.text: Pass whether or not the bug is fixed
options.rationale: Such a test does not guard anything.
Regression tests belong in CI, run before merge.
Removing code is not the same as testing the fix.

items.explanation: Correct: a red-then-green test proves it actually guards the bug.
